en.topic_title: Hong Kong men’s foil team claims historic silver at Fencing World Championships
en.topic_summary:
The Hong Kong men’s foil team has claimed a historic silver medal at the Fencing World Championships after narrowly losing 44-45 to world number-one Italy on home soil.



Hong Kong men’s foil team claim historic silver at the 2026 Fencing World Championships after a narrow 44-45 defeat to Italy on July 28, 2026, at the AsiaWorld-Expo. Photo: GovHK.
